script:
export const meta = {
  name: 'spike-wf',
  description: 'Tiny spike workflow with two phases',
  phases: [ { title: 'Ask', detail: 'two agents in parallel' }, { title: 'Merge', detail: 'one agent' } ],
}
phase('Ask')
const words = await parallel([
  () => agent('Reply with the single word ALPHA and nothing else.', { label: 'alpha', effort: 'low' }),
  () => agent('Reply with the single word BETA and nothing else.', { label: 'beta', effort: 'low' }),
])
phase('Merge')
const merged = await agent('Reply with exactly this text and nothing else: ' + words.join('-'), { label: 'merge', effort: 'low' })
log('merged ' + merged)
return merged
summary: Tiny spike workflow with two phases

workflowProgress.label: alpha

workflowProgress.promptPreview: Reply with the single word BETA and nothing else.
